summary: Full backend + frontend test of citizen auth (phone OTP dev mode), complaint moderation, notification bell delete, admin ban/delete, fullscreen toggle. 9/9 pytest + full Playwright flow — all PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/citizen/register uses in-memory 5/IP/hour rate limit — fine for prod but makes bulk testing from a single egress IP tricky. Could store rate-limit buckets in Mongo for distributed enforcement if later horizontally scaled.

complaint-hr rate limit (5/hr/IP) also counts attempts that are later rejected by the daily cap check inside submit_complaint. Harmless but slightly surprising; could move _rate_limit after validations if desired.
server.py is ~1467 lines — consider splitting complaints, notifications, citizens routers into separate modules (follows the pattern already established by citizen_auth.py).

seed_data_creation: Created transient citizens with TEST_/test_ prefixed emails and random PH phones for each run. Posted ~4 test complaints; admin-delete test cleaned up the primary one.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_citizen_flow.py. Run with: `pytest backend/tests/test_citizen_flow.py -v -o addopts=''`. Note: /api/citizen/register is 5/IP/hour and /api/public/complaints has a 5/IP/hour (complaint-hr) in-memory rate-limit; the project-dup test auto-restarts backend to reset buckets. Dev OTP code returned in register response as `dev_code` (Twilio not configured). All data-testids used by UI tests are already in place: public-nav-citizen-signin, complaint-signin-required, complaint-signup-link, cit-name/email/phone/password, cit-submit, phone-verify-card, otp-dev-hint, otp-input, otp-submit, public-nav-citizen, public-nav-citizen-logout, complaint-reporter, complaint-title/description/category, complaint-submit, complaint-submitted, complaint-verified-{id}, complaint-ban-{id}, complaint-delete-{id}, notif-bell, notif-panel, notif-item-{id}, notif-delete-{id}, notif-clear-all, fullscreen-toggle.

POST /api/citizen/verify-phone wrong code → 400; correct dev_code → 200 phone_verified=true
After verify: POST /api/public/complaints with title≥5, description≥20 → 200
Same project twice from same citizen → 409 (tested with juan.test)
